name: Genify
conditions: Free plan requires a backlink to genify.dev on your site
Free listings are 'Reviewed and listed within 72 hours' per pricing
Pro plan $4.9 one-time removes the backlink requirement, adds featured placement and social/newsletter sharing
requirements: Directory focus is 'generation tools' (AI text/image/voice/video generation and adjacent tools); listed items span a broad range
Account required: /submit shows login (email, Google, GitHub) via /auth/register
preparation: Product name, URL, description, images, category/tags
For free tier: a live backlink to genify.dev on your site before/around submission
workflow: Add the genify.dev backlink to your site if using the free plan
Complete the product form; free tier reviewed within ~72 hours
watchFor: 'Permanent link with backlink maintenance' wording implies the free listing depends on keeping the backlink live
Mkdirs-style directory; submit form fields are behind the auth wall
Pro is cheap ($4.9) and skips the backlink - weigh the cost of a footer link vs. paying
countsAsLive: The tool appears as a card on genify.dev with an /item/<slug> details page and 'Visit Website' outbound link.
unknowns: How many dofollow links a listing carries ('>= 3' claimed for paid)
Whether free-tier backlink compliance is re-verified
